# Keep dark-reader utility, test and UI names in their own namespaces

This family uses DarkReader.mjs for the packaged utility, lowerCamelCase exported helpers, browser_darkReader.js/test_darkReader.js filenames, and testLuminance/testContrast/testTransparency for pure helper tasks. The older browser helper names remain snake_case, so this is not a universal task-name rule. Current preferences use lowerCamelCase darkReader/darkReaderToggle IDs, dashed Fluent keys, and dotted preference names. Keep each exact import/resource/control spelling and use the local family when naming a new artifact.

Scope: Dark-reader module test and UI naming.
